stages.description: The life cycle in the order the reader walks it; every kind names one of these.

prefix.description: Two to four capitals (A-Z), checked when the registry is read.

folder.description: A place under docs/, like docs/requirements; checked when the registry is read.

kinds.description: The kinds the product holds, each naming its stage of the list.

title: Madarch product kinds registry
description: The shape of one product repository kinds registry file: the stages as an ordered list with no fixed kinds, and the kinds the product holds, each with its name, id prefix, folder, stage and next-step hint. The mechanism is madarch's; the kinds (usually written at setup by the skill set) are the product's data.
